description: This source file contains utility functions for interacting with Git repositories, such as listing changed files, resolving base commits, and detecting changed extensions within a project structure. It is used for managing extensions in a bundled plugin system, providing functions to list available extensions, detect changed extensions, and handle related Git operations.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a Git command synchronously with specified arguments and options, returning the command output.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a file path to a normalized format with forward slashes.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks if a specific Git commit or ref exists and is reachable.

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Determines the base commit to compare against, using various fallback mechanisms if necessary.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Lists file paths that have changed between two Git revisions.

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Checks if a given extension ID has a package.json inside the plugin's directory, indicating its presence.

methods.name: listAvailableExtensionIds
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of available extension IDs with valid package.json files.

methods.name: detectChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Analyzes changed file paths to deduce which extensions have been modified.

methods.name: listChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Combines the above functions to return a sorted list of extension IDs that have changed since a specific base, handling errors based on configuration.
